method: Independent derivation and numerical checks, separate from rendered text
claims: r=a exp(b theta) with b=ln(1.5)/(pi/2) multiplies radius by 1.5 for each quarter turn. Tangent direction is proportional to b e_r+e_theta, making the constant angle atan(1/b) with the outward radius.

Scaling by 1.5 then rotating by pi/2 maps the curve to itself with a shifted parameter; only overlapping portions of finite drawn curves coincide. This factor is not the golden spiral factor. Natural resemblance is not exact biological growth evidence.

checks.description: Scale and quarter turn map to shifted original points

limitations: Numerical samples verify implementation consistency, not a substitute for the stated general arguments.
